summary.text: Tiffany Strout is a Republican state representative from Maine House District 11, in office since December 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Keith Newman. She lives in Harrington.

paragraphs.text: Strout earned an associate degree from the University of Maine at Augusta in 2000.

Her career experience includes working as a business development manager with GenoTyping Center of America, a customer service representative with Wreaths Across America and a senior project manager with The Jackson Laboratory.
Strout took office on December 6, 2022, succeeding Ryan Fecteau, and she serves on the Marine Resources Committee.
